sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. A single dark-skinned adult woman in a near-frontal bust crop, face turned slightly toward screen-right and gaze near the viewer, with calm closed lips. Dark brown hair forms large swept rolled waves above the forehead and curled shoulder/nape-length ends at both sides; dark arched brows, smooth upper lip and chin. Thin pale-gold round spectacles with a visible bridge and side arms cover the eyes. She wears a grey fine-check garment with a broad pointed grey collar edged in rust-orange piping and two visible reddish-brown front buttons. No hat, medals or facial hair are visible. Preserve the upright shoulder crop, upper-left facial highlights and shaded right side. The complete 156x210 canvas is a continuous grey-olive painted background, darker at the upper corners and lighter beside the lower face, with no separate card frame, paper note or exterior cutout. Measured source alpha254..255; its painted rectangle is visually opaque. Exact original and nearest-neighbor enlargement actually observed; fine check weave and spectacle highlights have limited source resolution, so no invented tiny pattern is implied.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A single dark-skinned adult woman in an upright near-frontal bust, head slightly toward screen-right, gaze near the viewer and calm closed lips. Dark brown hair is exposed as a thick rolled wave over the forehead, with dark arched brows and a smooth upper lip/chin. A pale grey-olive headscarf covers the crown/sides behind the front hair and wraps under the chin; its neck folds are olive-gold with visible decorative gold patterning. She has no spectacles or separate hat. A dark brown coat has broad lapels and a raised collar around the scarf. Retain the layered scarf/coat contact, shoulder crop and soft upper-left light with shadow on the right. The 156x210 continuous painted grey-olive background fills the whole rectangle; no photo frame, paper note or exterior cutout is present. Actual source alpha254..255 and visually opaque backing. Exact original and nearest-neighbor enlargement were viewed; the tiny gold scarf motif is visible as ornament but individual motif shapes are not securely legible and should not be invented.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A single dark-skinned adult man in a chest/bust crop, head turned slightly toward screen-left and eyes near the viewer. Very short close dark hair with a gently waved/combed top and dark eyebrows; smooth chin/jaw and no separate visible moustache, beard, spectacles or hat. His mouth is partly open around a brown cigar projecting diagonally down toward screen-left; pale grey smoke rises from its left tip in a narrow curling plume. Preserve this cigar, mouth placement and smoke rather than adding a hand. He wears a dark charcoal overcoat with a tall turned-up collar and broad notched lapels, a pale tan pointed shirt collar and a darker inner garment visible below. Maintain the short neck framed naturally by shirt and raised coat collar, the original shoulder crop and soft upper-left face light. The complete 156x210 grey-olive painted backing is darker above and lighter beside the lower face; no card frame, paper note or exterior transparent cutout. Actual source alpha254..255; visually opaque full rectangle. Exact original, full nearest-neighbor and face nearest-neighbor detail were actually viewed.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A single dark-skinned adult man in a near-frontal chest/bust crop, head angled slightly toward screen-left with gaze near the viewer and a faint closed-mouth smile. A narrow dark upper-lip line is visible; at this exact source resolution fine moustache hairs cannot be securely distinguished from upper-lip/nose shading, so record that evidence limit without claiming a proved moustache or adding a thick beard. Preserve the natural shirt collar closure, upright shoulders, upper-left facial highlights and darker right face.
